decisions.quote:
Focal test: attitudes towards vaccines were negatively predicted by “outgroup” conspiracy theories, beta = -.45, 95% CI[-.36; -.54], t = -10.16, p < .001.

Reproduction result: Attitudes towards vaccines were negatively predicted by “outgroup” conspiracy theories (beta = -.4502, 95%CI[-.3631; -.5373], t = -10.161, p < .001.

decisions.reason: With the target identity resolved to Bertin, Nera, & Delouvée (2020), the reproduction re-ran the focal hierarchical regression on the original Study 1 dataset and recovered the original reported statistics (beta = -.4502, 95% CI [-.3631; -.5373], t = -10.161, p < .001 vs. reported beta = -.45, 95% CI [-.36; -.54], t = -10.16, p < .001), matching to rounding. Both shipped and blind correctly coded 'computationally reproducible'.
